concept.name: CitrusBurst Sparkling Water
concept.description: CitrusBurst is a premium sparkling water infused with natural citrus oils. Zero calories, zero sweeteners — just crisp bubbles with a bright lemon-lime finish. Available in sleek 12oz slim cans, sold in 8-packs for $6.99. Designed for health-conscious adults who want flavor without compromise.
